title: Foundations of Independent Component Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.13229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present the mathematical foundations of linear independent component analysis (ICA) models based on standard literature in a self-contained note. It is aimed at readers with a background in measure-theoretic probability theory. We first develop the theory of the characteristic functions of probability measures on $\mathbb{R}^d$, including their analyticity and the way in which they determine and characterise the distributions. We then focus on several identifiability results of ICA models with successively strengthened assumptions on the sources: from merely non-constant, to non-Gaussian, to Gaussian-free independent sources. Under the strictest assumptions, we show that the independent sources are identifiable up to translation, permutation, scales and signs, and this even in the presence of additive Gaussian noise. Furthermore, we present the online equivariant gradient descent ICA algorithm for recovering the independent sources

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13229v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们基于标准文献，以自包含的笔记形式呈现线性独立成分分析（ICA）模型的数学基础。它面向具有测度论概率论背景的读者。我们首先发展 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上概率测度特征函数的理论，包括其解析性以及它们确定和表征分布的方式。然后，我们关注在逐步增强源假设下的ICA模型的几个可识别性结果：从仅非恒定，到非高斯，再到无高斯独立源。在最严格的假设下，我们证明独立源在平移、排列、尺度和符号方面是可识别的，即使在存在加性高斯噪声的情况下也是如此。此外，我们提出了用于恢复独立源的在线等变梯度下降ICA算法。
tldr: 本文系统阐述了线性独立成分分析的数学基础，并证明了在严格假设下源信号的可识别性，即使存在高斯噪声，同时提出了一种在线等变梯度下降算法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically presents the mathematical foundations of linear ICA, proving identifiability of sources under strict assumptions even with Gaussian noise, and introduces an online equivariant gradient descent algorithm.
